comment: Single source of truth for netlab impairment profiles. delayMs is ONE-WAY per direction: the in-process PacketImpairment applies it to each direction separately, and scripts/netem.sh applies it on lo egress which both directions traverse once. lossPct is per-packet. Netlab v2 (docs/netlab-v2.md) reads the same table for its seeded link model; loopback, lan, cable, poor-mobile, lossy-wifi and bw-capped were added for it; cap-1mbit and the *-nq profiles for rate adaptation. bottleneckQueueMs (Netlab v2 only) puts the bottleneck queue in the network instead of at the sender.

cap-1mbit.comment: bw-capped at 1 Mbit/s: a clean rate cap, no loss (Netlab v2 rate adaptation)

cap-1mbit-nq.comment: cap-1mbit with the queue in the network, as quinn's BBR behaves (Netlab v2 only: bottleneckQueueMs)

bw-capped-nq.comment: bw-capped with the queue in the network (Netlab v2 only)

poor-mobile-nq.comment: poor-mobile with the queue in the network (Netlab v2 only)
